import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from doorstop import Doorstop, Requirement

class TestDoorstopRequirements(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.doorstop = Doorstop()

    @patch('doorstop.storage.Storage.store')
    def test_store_requirements_permanently(self, mock_store):
        # Test storing requirements
        requirement = Requirement(id='REQ001', title='Sample Requirement', description='This is a sample requirement.')
        self.doorstop.add_requirement(requirement)
        self.doorstop.store_requirements()
        mock_store.assert_called_once_with(requirement)

    @patch('doorstop.storage.Storage.store')
    def test_handle_change_management(self, mock_store):
        # Test change management
        requirement = Requirement(id='REQ001', title='Sample Requirement', description='This is a sample requirement.')
        self.doorstop.add_requirement(requirement)
        requirement.description = 'Updated description'
        self.doorstop.store_requirements()
        mock_store.assert_called_with(requirement)

    @patch('doorstop.storage.Storage.store')
    def test_associate_changes_with_developer(self, mock_store):
        # Test associating changes with developer
        requirement = Requirement(id='REQ001', title='Sample Requirement', description='This is a sample requirement.')
        self.doorstop.add_requirement(requirement)
        requirement.description = 'Updated description'
        requirement.developer_id = 'dev123'
        self.doorstop.store_requirements()
        mock_store.assert_called_with(requirement)
        self.assertEqual(requirement.developer_id, 'dev123')

    @patch('doorstop.storage.Storage.store')
    def test_scalability_with_thousands_of_requirements(self, mock_store):
        # Test scalability with thousands of requirements
        for i in range(1000):
            requirement = Requirement(id=f'REQ{i:03}', title=f'Sample Requirement {i}', description='This is a sample requirement.')
            self.doorstop.add_requirement(requirement)
        self.doorstop.store_requirements()
        self.assertEqual(mock_store.call_count, 1000)

    @patch('doorstop.storage.Storage.install')
    def test_lightweight_installation(self, mock_install):
        # Test lightweight installation
        self.doorstop.install()
        mock_install.assert_called_once()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
